response.sql: WITH status_stats AS (SELECT s.healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) as total_scans, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) as avg_ratio_per_status FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY s.healtheval), mean_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio_per_status) as overall_mean FROM status_stats) SELECT ss.healtheval, ss.total_scans, ss.avg_ratio_per_status, ss.avg_ratio_per_status - mr.overall_mean as diff_from_mean FROM status_stats ss CROSS JOIN mean_ratio mr WHERE mr.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
